status: Read-only documentation review; no deck generated and no solver setting changed

sources.finding: CNVTOL uses NORM=2 (L2) for force by default; NORM=1 selects sum of absolute residual terms. Explicit VALUE fixes the reference, and TOLER multiplies it. Other convergence labels remain unchanged.

Convergence compares a residual vector norm with reference times tolerance. Constrained displacement DOFs use restoring forces for the reference; contact can influence calculated minimum references. Predictor extrapolates prior displacement history.

Lagrange rigid links retain participating DOFs. Documentation cautions against overconstraint and unnecessarily many elements. Direct elimination has different reaction-output limitations, so switching formulation would require separate physical validation.

analyst_inference: A scalar L2 residual criterion is not identical to a global component reaction sum. For an untransformed nodal residual vector, Cauchy-Schwarz permits a component sum up to sqrt(N) times its L2 norm. This does not establish the source of the observed imbalance in this constrained model; native all-node PRRSOL independently confirms the failed balance.
candidate_next_numerical_check: After the current run ends and its full outcome is diagnosed, consider a fresh short fine-mesh sibling with explicit absolute L1 force residual control during pull, while keeping preload, geometry, material, contact and moment/displacement controls unchanged.
